title: Make your learning visible
description: Build an honest AI skills portfolio with useful projects, clear methods, and verifiable results.

sections.title: Choose projects with a real purpose
sections.body: Select a small problem relevant to the work you want to do. A source-backed briefing, an accessible presentation, or a tested spreadsheet workflow can be more informative than a flashy demonstration with no clear purpose. Use public, licensed, or synthetic inputs and protect information from your employer or clients.
bullets: State who the project helps and why.
Define what success would look like before starting.

sections.title: Document your process and decisions
sections.body: Explain the inputs, tools, instructions, review steps, and changes you made. Include an example of a weak result and how you corrected it. Make your own contribution explicit. If you report a time saving or quality improvement, explain how you measured it and the limits of that comparison.
bullets: Keep prompts and source material where sharing is permitted.
Record errors as well as improvements.

sections.title: Present a clear, honest case study
sections.body: Use a short structure: problem, method, result, and lessons. Provide a working example or screenshots where appropriate. Avoid invented clients, qualifications, or performance claims. A useful portfolio helps someone understand how you think, not just that a tool produced an attractive output.
bullets: Explain what you would change next.
Check accessibility, permissions, and links before sharing.

example.title: A portfolio outline
example.text: Problem: a public guide is difficult to navigate. Method: use AI to propose a structure, verify content manually, and test navigation with a colleague. Result: show the revised guide and describe feedback without claiming unmeasured business impact.

exercise: Draft a one-page case study outline for a project you can complete using public or fictional information.

faq.question: Can I include workplace projects?
faq.answer: Only with permission and appropriate removal of confidential information. A recreated example using synthetic inputs may be safer.

faq.question: Should I mention AI assistance?
faq.answer: Describe the tools and your contribution clearly. Follow any relevant employer, educational, or publishing disclosure rules.
